title: Box 27
logline: Box 27's lid, close, its register line pencilled, the flaps open, the top page a bus window. The boxes keep count of the year's sequences; the page keeps count of the boxes.

panels.composition: Close on a cardboard box lid with a number and a pencilled line beneath it, the flaps open, the top sheet inside showing a drawn bus window with rain.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, close on a cardboard box lid marked with a number and a pencilled line beneath, its flaps open and the top sheet inside showing a drawing of a rainy bus window, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
